result.topic_en: Gauss derives a series expansion for log sin p when p = q + h sin q with h a cosine series in odd multiples of q, then applies it with specific coefficients in powers of f to obtain log cos φ as a Fourier series in ψ.
result.transcription:
Kr \quad Zur Berechnung von log. cos φ \quad [Band IX p. 180 f] \quad 143.
Ist $p = q + h\sin q$, so wird
$\log\sin p = \log\sin q + h\cos q - \frac{1}{2}hh + \frac{1}{3}h^3\cos q - \frac{1}{12}h^4(1+2\cos q^2)\ldots$
Also, $h = a\cos q + b\cos 3q + c\cos 5q + d\cos 7q$ gesetzt:
$\log\sin p = \log\sin q + [\frac{1}{2}a - \frac{1}{4}aa + \frac{1}{8}a^3 - \frac{1}{12}a^4 + \frac{1}{8}aab - \frac{1}{4}bb]$
$+\cos 2q[\frac{1}{2}a - \frac{1}{4}aa + \frac{1}{2}b - \frac{1}{2}ab + \frac{1}{6}a^3 - \frac{23}{192}a^4 + \frac{3}{8}aab]$
$+\cos 4q[\frac{1}{2}b - \frac{1}{2}ab + \frac{1}{2}c + \frac{1}{24}a^3 - \frac{1}{24}a^4 + \frac{3}{8}aab - \frac{1}{2}ac)$
$+\cos 6q[\frac{1}{2}c - \frac{1}{192}a^4 + \frac{1}{8}aab - \frac{1}{2}ac - \frac{1}{4}bb + \frac{1}{2}d$
$+\cos 8q[\frac{1}{2}d$
In unserm Fall ist
$a = -12ff - 54f^4 - \frac{1144}{3}f^6 - 3367f^8$
$b = +42f^4 + \frac{1412}{3}f^6 + 4793f^8$
$c = -\frac{604}{3}f^6 - 3735f^8$
$d = +1097f^8$
Also
$\log\cos\varphi = \log\cos\psi - 6ff - [-62-]{+63+}f^4 - \frac{2192}{3}f^6 - \frac{17559}{2}f^8$
$+(6ff + 42f^4 + \frac{946}{3}f^6 + 2200f^8)\cos 2\psi$
$+(21f^4 + \frac{944}{3}f^6 + 3711[?]f^8)\cos 4\psi$
$+\frac{302}{3}f^6 + 2320f^8)\cos 6\psi$
$+\frac{1097}{2}f^8)\cos 8\psi$
[margin, pencil:] muss $\frac{18059}{2}$ heissen[?] Kr.
